title: Stipendium Hungaricum Application Overview + Mentor Guidance + Live Q&A
description: Understand the Stipendium Hungaricum application before the season becomes stressful. Learn how programme selection, the sending-partner process, documents, motivation, and scholarship preparation connect.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: As a Stipendium Hungaricum Scholar, I'm here to simplify your application journey! From improvising your CV and motivation letter to sharing entrance exam/interview tips and my struggles and turning points through the process, I've got your back! Together, we will ensure your journey is organised, confident and successful.
outcomesHeading: After 90 minutes, you will have a clearer plan
outcomesIntro: 3 outcomes distilled from a successful study-abroad path.
roadmapIntro: Four parts, one live Q&A — every minute mapped to a decision you will face.

testimonialsHeading: Students who walked away with a plan

testimonials.quote: It was a very helpful session. Many of my confusions are clear now, and my AbroadMate gave me proper direction for my next steps. They carefully analyzed my background and goals and provided detailed feedback along with some useful website links. I really appreciated the guidance and would like to book another session in the near future.

I enjoy receiving personalized guidance based on my academic background and career goals. My AbroadMate provides clear advice on scholarships, university selection, and application strategies, and answers my questions patiently — which makes the whole process much easier and more motivating.

I really appreciated how humble and patient my AbroadMate was. An exceptional listener who carefully heard out all my problems and provided clear, practical solutions. They gave me plenty of time without any rush, which made the session incredibly helpful and reassuring.
